promise.text: Camp and school health forms: what to have ready

lines.text: Camp, school and sports forms ask for the same things every year.
Have your answers on one page, and know which part only the doctor can fill in.

eyebrow.text: Work through it in this order

head.text: Get this year's forms and read the instructions before you write anything.

body.text: Find the return date and mark which pages are yours and which are for the provider.

eyebrow.text: Work through it in this order

head.text: Book the provider's visit first, since it depends on someone else's calendar.

body.text: The ACA form's instructions are to give the provider a copy of your completed parent pages along with their own page.

eyebrow.text: Work through it in this order

head.text: Fill in your pages by copying from your one page, not from memory.

body.text: Where the form asks something your page doesn't hold, write it on your page too, so next year it's there.

eyebrow.text: Work through it in this order

head.text: For vaccines, attach a copy of the record.

body.text: The ACA form says copies from a health-care provider or a state or local government are acceptable, and asks for the month and year of each dose.
Ask your provider's office for the record if you don't have it.

eyebrow.text: Work through it in this order

head.text: List every medicine, including vitamins and natural remedies.

body.text: The ACA form defines medication that broadly.
Check the camp's rules on packaging: the form notes that many states require original pharmacy containers with labels, and a sample ACA camp policy says the same and has a nurse handle them.

line.text: A Forms sheet with the answers those forms ask for, in the order they ask, so you copy from one page instead of finding each fact again.
